title: Provenance
description: SDD-R001 §21 (object provenance) and SDD-R003 §13 (relationship provenance). Objects without provenance shall never become official OEP Reference Library objects (SDD-R001 §21).

author.description: The individual or organization that authored this Engineering Knowledge Object or relationship.

reviewer.description: The individual or organization that performed engineering review. Required before status may be Published (SDD-R008 §13).

created_date.description: ISO-8601 date this content was first authored.

revision_date.description: ISO-8601 date of the most recent substantive revision.

confidence.description: Qualitative confidence in engineering accuracy, distinct from review_status.

content_license.description: The license under which this authored content (not the engineering fact itself) is distributed.
